archive_license_claim: CC BY 4.0; original capture provenance not independently verified
decision: Exclude sampled source from balloon training: clear objects are textured/seamed balls; degraded views are ambiguous. Source title is not ground truth. This is not an exhaustive claim about all upstream images.

duplicate_screen.references: Hash-bound Matterport sources, six EngDes2 review queues, all 1230 reserved IMG_ images, upstream validation images, and previously selected frames
duplicate_screen.limitation: Perceptual hashing does not establish recording-session independence or detect every rotated/cropped/nearby-frame duplicate.
duplicate_screen.heldout_pixels: Automated duplicate screening only; no display, classification, calibration, negative mining or training

duplicate_screen_optimization.change: Compute each reflected query fingerprint once, then compare against vectorized references instead of recomputing per reference
duplicate_screen_optimization.scope: Dataset preparation only, not Pi inference. The saved review queue was generated before this optimization. Timing is one illustrative host run, not a repeatability claim.
